materials.content_scope: Course description, catalog fields, normalized link records, and provenance only; no lectures, readings, labs, or assignment bodies.

blocked.item: Official lecture, slide, reading, lab, project, and assignment contents
blocked.reason: No such content was supplied or retrieved; catalog URLs are not content.
blocked.effect: Do not claim coverage, availability, or completion based on the links.

blocked.reason: This bounded preparation job performed no network retrieval or access verification.
blocked.effect: A later authorized ingestion job must retrieve and validate each item before use.

blocked.item: Third-party GitHub assignment and student-style repositories
blocked.reason: They may contain solutions, another learner's work, unclear licensing, or content from an unmatched course offering.
blocked.effect: Keep out of learner views until provenance, license, offering, and answer-leakage reviews pass.

blocked.reason: Assessment criteria and expected-answer guidance are examiner-only.
blocked.effect: Never copy examiner_only/RUBRIC.md into student_safe or a learner attempt.

future_retrieval_requires: Explicit authorization and an allowed destination inside a per-attempt workspace.
A captured source URL, retrieval time, immutable content digest, source identity, and course-offering label.
Access and license review before redistribution.
Item-level classification as official, third-party, or learner-authored; a normalized record alone is insufficient.
A learner-safety scan for answers, hidden grading data, secrets, sealed references, and another learner's files.
Validator confirmation before an ingested item can expand the unit graph or support a completion claim.
retrieval_policy.on_failure: Record the item as unavailable with the failure reason; do not substitute an unsupported claim or silently use another offering.
retrieval_policy.source_repository_policy: Treat catalog source repositories as read-only inputs and copy only reviewed, authorized artifacts into the attempt workspace.
